mechanisms.routing: raised event / registers MSDP REPORT subscription
mechanisms.file: AbandonedRealms -  Gui Add-on - Tick, affects and map.xml
mechanisms.notes: Enabling mechanism. A trigger firing on '[INFO] MXP version 1.0 detected and enabled.' sends MSDP REPORT to subscribe to AFFECTS/WORLD_TIME/ROOM_MAP/ROOM_NAME/AREA_NAME. AbandonedRealms is an MSDP game. NOTE: this package requests NO hp/mana/movement vitals at all - only affects, time, map and room/area names. An 'affects window' script also force-enables MSDP via setConfig('enableMSDP', true) on sysConnectionEvent.

mechanisms.file: AbandonedRealms -  Gui Add-on - Tick, affects and map.xml
mechanisms.notes: msdp.AFFECTS is a table mapping affect-name -> remaining-duration string (e.g. 'Spell:sanctuary' -> '2 hours'/'12 rounds'/'0 moments'). Package parses duration strings into 'moments' (1 hour = 120 moments, 1 round = 12 moments; 0 hours = 119, negative = permanent/-1) and colours yellow when <=120 moments. Force-shows sanctuary/armor even when down. No max/scale - duration text only. Affect names stripped of 'Spell:' / 'Power::' prefixes.

mechanisms.file: AbandonedRealms -  Gui Add-on - Tick, affects and map.xml
mechanisms.notes: In-game world time / tick counter. When msdp.WORLD_TIME changes vs stored CURRENTTIME, a game 'hour'/tick is detected: raises 'Tick' event and drives a colour-coded countdown label (green->yellow->orange->red via tempTimers), plus raises 'lateTick'. Also echoed verbatim to timelabel. Not a scaled gauge.

mechanisms.notes: ASCII minimap string; backtick colour codes (`0-`9, `!, `@ etc) translated to ansi tags and rendered in a MiniConsole. Positional/map data, not a stat gauge.

Current health = matches[2] from the Achaea default prompt 'Xh, Xm, Xe, Xw ...'. Max (maxHealth) comes from the score screen (see 'Score (h/w)' entry). Displayed as a custom label-based bar: 'healthMax' coloured label (RGB 221,0,51) is resized over a fixed 55px-wide 'healthBar' background label. Prompt-format assumption: relies on Achaea's stock numeric prompt format; integers, no commas, no percentages. If score has not been parsed yet maxHealth is nil (bar breaks until 'score' run).
Current mana = matches[3]. Max (maxMana) from score screen ('Score (m/e)'). manaMax label RGB 0,204,255 resized over fixed manaBar background.
Current endurance = matches[4]. Max (maxEndurance) from score screen ('Score (m/e)'). enduranceMax label RGB 255,204,51.
Current willpower = matches[5]. Max (maxWillpower) from score screen ('Score (h/w)'). willpowerMax label RGB 153,102,204.

Parses the boxed SCORE screen line 'Health  : cur/max   Willpower: cur/max'. Captures the MAX for health and willpower into globals maxHealth/maxWillpower. This is THE source of maxima for the health & willpower prompt bars. Only max is captured here (current comes from the prompt). Numbers are plain integers, no commas.
Parses SCORE screen line 'Mana : cur/max   Endurance: cur/max'. Captures MAX mana and endurance into globals. Source of maxima for the mana & endurance prompt bars.

mechanisms.pattern: Password correct. Welcome to Achaea.  (mCommand sends: score)
mechanisms.routing: sends 'score' (mCommand) plus 'l' and 'map' to elicit score/room data
mechanisms.notes: IMPORTANT: package auto-SENDS 'score' on login (trigger mCommand=score) so the maxHealth/maxMana/maxEndurance/maxWillpower score-parse triggers fire and populate the gauge maxima. Also sends 'l' and 'map'. So gauge maxima are bootstrapped automatically once per login; if the user never re-runs score, the max stays stale after leveling/stat changes.

mechanisms.pattern: ^\d+h, \d+m, \d+e, \d+w (.*)   then filter child on 'x' sets balance=true
mechanisms.notes: Balance state read from the prompt's trailing flag block. Parent filter trigger captures the flag string after 'Xh, Xm, Xe, Xw '; children are single-letter substring triggers: 'x'=balance. Parent resets balance=false each prompt, child sets balance=true when 'x' present. Stored to global only (no visible gauge routing found).

mechanisms.pattern: ^\d+h, \d+m, \d+e, \d+w (.*)   then filter child on 'e' sets equilibrum=true
mechanisms.notes: Equilibrium ('e' flag in prompt tail) -> global equilibrum=true; reset false each prompt. Variable only.

mechanisms.pattern: ^\d+h, \d+m, \d+e, \d+w (.*)   then filter children on 'b','d','k','c' set blind/deaf/kola/cloak
mechanisms.notes: Prompt-tail single-letter affect/state flags parsed via filter-child substring triggers: 'b'=blind, 'd'=deaf, 'k'=kola nut (kolaNut=true), 'c'=cloak (cloakUp=true). blind/deaf reset to false each prompt in the filter-chain parent. Stored to globals only. Note: naive single-char substring triggers can false-match letters elsewhere on the line.

mechanisms.routing: Geyser.Gauge GUI.hpbar:setValue(value,max) via 0.25s interpolate(); also stored in vitals.health.{current,max,previous} and PLAYER.gmcpData.hp/maxhp; derived php=floor(hp/maxhp*100)
mechanisms.notes: IRE GMCP sends vitals as STRINGS; tonumber() applied everywhere. maxhp lives in the same Char.Vitals object. hpbar is one of 5 Geyser.Gauge bars created at line 26605. Package computes its own percentages php/pmp/pep/pwp (lines 19033-19036).

mechanisms.routing: Geyser.Gauge GUI.mpbar:setValue(value,max) via interpolate(); vitals.mana.{current,max}; PLAYER.gmcpData.mp/maxmp; derived pmp
mechanisms.notes: string values, tonumber applied; maxmp same GMCP object. Drives 'sip mana' auto-cure logic (fullsipper line 29904).

mechanisms.routing: Geyser.Gauge GUI.wpbar:setValue(value,max) via interpolate(); vitals.wp.{current,max}; PLAYER.gmcpData.wp/maxwp; derived pwp
mechanisms.notes: string values; willpower is the IRE 4th resource. getResourceData maps willpower->wp/maxwp (line 18948).

mechanisms.routing: Geyser.Gauge GUI.epbar:setValue(value,max) via interpolate(); vitals.ep.{current,max}; PLAYER.gmcpData.ep/maxep; derived pep
mechanisms.notes: string values; endurance maps to ep/maxep (line 18949). IRE has no separate 'movement/stamina' - ep/wp are the extra resources.

mechanisms.routing: variable PLAYER.gmcpData.bal / PLAYER.gmcpData.eq (booleans); consumed by balance_data / curing timing
mechanisms.notes: bal (balance) and eq (equilibrium) arrive as string '1'/'0' and are compared == "1". Boolean state, not a gauge value. balanceGMCP also registered on gmcp.Char.Vitals (line 30840).

mechanisms.routing: Geyser.Gauge GUI.xpbar:setValue(rank,100); vitals.rank.{current=floor(xp),max=100}; PLAYER.gmcpData.xp; scorewindow label echo of gmcp.Char.Status.level
mechanisms.notes: xp is a percentage toward next level; rank gauge max HARDCODED to 100. gmcp.Char.Status.level is a string like '123 (45.6%)' - level and xp% parsed out via string.match (lines 19074-19077).

mechanisms.pattern: gmcp.Char.Vitals.charstats[] = array of strings 'Rage: 50','Kai: 20','Bleed: 0','Venom: x','Karma: 100','Stance: y','Essence','Wrath'... parsed via v:match(statName..':%s*(.+)')
mechanisms.routing: global vars (_G.rage,kai,bleed,karma,stance,venom,...) via updateStat/getCharStat; shown in decorated prompt() and class-resource prompt token
mechanisms.notes: charstats is a positional array of 'Label: Value' strings pushed inside Char.Vitals. Rage parsed at 19044 (charstats[2] 'Rage:%s*(%d+)'), Kai/Karma numeric via tonumber, Bleed read in clotcheck (line 30567). No max provided - current-value only, some class-specific.
all currency arrive as STRINGS, tonumber() applied, no thousands-commas. tgold=gold+bank computed. Also last_gold_snapshot=gmcp.Char.Status.gold (line 36460, kill-gold tracking).

mechanisms.routing: variable myaffs{} / mystackableaffs{} + curing pipeline + prompt tags ([A]eon,[R]etardation etc)
mechanisms.notes: Server-pushed affliction list. Stackable affs (burning, crackedribs...) parse a '(N)' count from the name. Drives the whole auto-curing engine. registered on Add/Remove/List events.

mechanisms.routing: variable mydefs{} / defenses{} .active/.enabled; defence-up pipeline; prompt [DEF] tag
mechanisms.notes: Buff/defence tracking (server-pushed). Filters out morph/harmony/parrying. Boolean present/absent state.

mechanisms.routing: variable gmcp.IRE.Target.Info.hpperc + DPS.currentTarget{id,name}; enemy health also rendered via server-side prompt token *T
mechanisms.notes: hpperc is a STRING percentage 0-100 (init '-1'); implicit max 100. Requires 'Core.Supports.Add ["IRE.Target 1"]' (sent line 20098). DPS module (registerNamedEventHandler, line 35674) uses IRE.Target for target identity; actual damage numbers come from combat-text triggers, not vitals.

mechanisms.routing: variable PLAYER.gmcpData.me.{name,race,class,...} + raiseEvent("gmcpData.me"); class used to pick prompt resource token (Karma/Kai/Venom...)
mechanisms.notes: Character identity/class. class string drives which class-resource (charstats) is shown. Dragon/elemental normalisation. Not a gauge, but feeds class-conditional resource display.

mechanisms.pattern: send("CONFIG PROMPT CUSTOM "..promptstring)  with server tokens *s *h *%h *m *w *e *b *d *c *k *R *a *i *v *x *t *T
mechanisms.routing: server-side in-game prompt display (NOT parsed back by the package); Mudlet prompt() function separately decorates the line from GMCP-sourced 'vitals' table
mechanisms.notes: IMPORTANT prompt-format assumption: the package CONTROLS the in-game prompt itself via 'CONFIG PROMPT CUSTOM'/'CONFIG PROMPT OFF' - it does NOT require the user to set a prompt and does NOT parse the prompt for vitals. ALL vitals capture is GMCP (Char.Vitals/Char.Status/IRE.Target). Tokens like *h/*%h (health/health%), *T (enemy hp), *x (rank) are rendered server-side for the human; percentages use * / *% prefixes.

mechanisms.routing: label echo - echo("pHealth",.."h"), echo("pMana",.."m"), echo("pEnderence",.."e"), echo("pWillpower",.."w"); matches[6]=EqBalPrompt drives updateEqBal() label colors
mechanisms.notes: Older/first prompt parser. Plain integers, no commas. Requires Achaea's h/m/e/w prompt format. matches[5]=balance/eq letter cluster, matches[6] captured as EqBalPrompt. Only echoes current numbers to labels, no gauge scaling here.

mechanisms.routing: resizeWindow of homemade bar labels: resizeWindow("healthMax",55/100*((100/maxHealth)*health),10) and same for manaMax/enduranceMax/willpowerMax
mechanisms.notes: Main gauge-scaling parser. Scales width of label bars using maxHealth/maxMana/maxEndurance/maxWillpower globals obtained from the score screen. Optional (p) prefix handled. Plain integers, no commas.
Parses SCORE output cur/max. This is THE maxima source for the prompt detector's bar scaling. Format cur/max with slash; current values ignored, only max (group 3 and 5) stored.
Parses SCORE output cur/max for endurance and willpower maxima. Feeds prompt detector bar scaling.

mechanisms.routing: raised command - trigger mCommand sends 'score' (plus send('l'), send('map')) on login to populate maxima
mechanisms.notes: Package SENDS 'score' automatically at login to obtain the max values consumed by the Score (h/m) and Score (e/w) triggers.
Package SENDS 'show xp' after each kill (corpse retrieval) to elicit the level/xp line parsed by the xpbar trigger.

mechanisms.pattern: ^You are level (\d+) (.*) and (\d+)% of the way to the next level.$
mechanisms.notes: Parses 'show xp' output. matches[2]=level, matches[4]=xp percent. Gauge max hardcoded to 100 since xp is a 0-100 percentage. Uses legacy createGauge/setGauge (Xpbar), not Geyser.

mechanisms.routing: label echo("Gold", gold.."g") and stores gold variable
mechanisms.notes: Captures gold count from a 'N gold sovereigns.' line (e.g. on GOLD/inventory). Plain integer, no commas.

mechanisms.pattern: ^You put (\d+) gold sovereigns in a magically-preserved letter.$
mechanisms.routing: variable + label - gold = gold + matches[2]; echo("Gold", .."g")
mechanisms.notes: Increments running gold tally when gold is deposited into a letter. Plain integer.

mechanisms.pattern: ^You get (\d+) gold sovereigns from a magically-preserved letter.$
mechanisms.routing: variable + label - gold = gold - matches[2]; echo("Gold", .."g")
mechanisms.notes: Decrements running gold tally when gold is withdrawn from a letter. Plain integer.

mechanisms.pattern: ^\d+h, \d+m, \d+e, \d+w (.*)  (filter chain; child single-letter matchers: x=balance, e=equilibrum, b=blind, k=kola, c=cloak, d=deaf)
mechanisms.routing: variable only - sets booleans balance/equilibrum/blind/kolaNut/cloakUp/deaf from the prompt's affect-letter cluster
mechanisms.notes: Parses the balance/equilibrium/affect letters trailing the Achaea prompt. Filter parent resets flags each prompt; child triggers match single letters (x,e,b,k,c,d). Also colored via EqBalPrompt in the prompt grabber -> updateEqBal() sets ballabel/eqlabel red/green.

mechanisms.pattern: ^(The doll looks to have been fashioned (\d+) times.)$
mechanisms.routing: variable only (sets fashions = tonumber(matches[3])) plus replaceLine echo
mechanisms.notes: Vodun class combat resource: number of 'fashions' worked into a wielded vodun doll (not a standard vital). The package SENDS the probe command 'p doll' automatically - the 'Doll Wielded' trigger (line 92-117) carries mCommand 'p doll' so wielding a doll elicits this line, which is then parsed for the current count. Plain integer, no commas, no percent. No max used for scaling; a hardcoded threshold of 30 appears in the 'Using One OR Zero Fashions' trigger (if fashions < 30).

mechanisms.pattern: You quickly sneak in another fashion.
mechanisms.routing: variable only (fashions = fashions + 1) plus cecho echo
mechanisms.notes: Increment trigger: bumps the fashions counter by 1 on any of ~8 doll-fashioning emote lines (rope/cloth, examine, mould arms/legs, nose/ears/eyes, fingers/toes, heart, final touches). Pure client-side running counter, no game-reported total.

mechanisms.pattern: ^You spin a doll of (\w+) rapidly in a circle\.$
mechanisms.routing: variable only (fashions = fashions - N) plus cecho echo
mechanisms.trigger_name: Using One Fashion (+ Using Two/Four/Five/Six/Seven/Ten/Thirty Fashions)
mechanisms.notes: Decrement triggers: a family of ~9 triggers each subtracts a fixed amount (1,2,4,5,6,7,10,30) from the fashions counter when the corresponding vodun curse emote fires. Client-side spend tracking of the same 'other' resource; no max, no game-reported number.

mechanisms.routing: variable only (used as theme name to pick UI colour palette)
mechanisms.notes: agnosticDB is a generic key/value database library; its ONLY character-data read is gmcp.Char.Status.City (note the capital 'City', unlike akayan which reads lowercase '.city'). Read as a string, guarded by 'if not gmcp or not gmcp.Char or not gmcp.Char.Status'. Value is stripped of any parenthetical suffix (:gsub('%b()','')) and trimmed, lowercased; 'none'/'rogue' map to 'rogue'. Used only for auto_city UI theming - no gauge, no vital, no max. Not polled on an event; resolved on demand when a theme name is needed.

Read inside Login_Event(), wired to the Mudlet 'logged in' sysLoginEvent (eventHandlerList <string>logged in</string>). Value echoed verbatim into a Vyzor character-bio label; no numeric parsing, no max, single snapshot at login (not refreshed on later gmcp.Char.Status updates).

Echoed verbatim to an 'EXP' label on the 'logged in' event. In IRE/Achaea gmcp.Char.Status.xp is typically a percent-to-next-level string (e.g. '51%'); package does no parsing and tracks no max. Single login snapshot only.

mechanisms.routing: variable / comparison (compared to p1/p2/p3 fishing-competitor names to attribute a catch)
mechanisms.notes: Character name string used only to decide whether the local player caught the fish (if p1 == gmcp.Char.Status.name ...). Not a vital; drives the fishing-competition score/weight counters.
City name string echoed to a bio label on the 'logged in' event. Note lowercase '.city' here vs agnosticDB's '.City'.
House/guild name string echoed to bio label on 'logged in' event.
Race string echoed to bio label on 'logged in' event.
Specialisation string echoed to bio label on 'logged in' event.

Class string echoed to bio label on 'logged in' event. This package captures NO hp/mp/vitals - it reads gmcp.Char.Status.{level,xp,name,city,house,race,specialisation,class} plus gmcp.Char.Items.List/Add/Remove (room-items only, location=='room', an info-here box, not inventory/vitals). Its distanceGauge is a Vyzor gauge over fishing.currentLine/fishing.maxLine with maxLine hardcoded to 500 (line 1377) - a fishing-line meter, not a character vital.

mechanisms.routing: variable / comparison (compared to p1/p2/p3 competitor names to attribute a catch to a Vyzor score/weight label)
mechanisms.notes: Fishing-competition UI. The ONLY character-data read is gmcp.Char.Status.name (string), used to test if the local player landed the fish (if p1 == gmcp.Char.Status.name ...). No hp/mp/vitals anywhere. The visible distanceGauge is a Vyzor.Gauge over fishing.currentLine/fishing.maxLine with maxLine hardcoded to 500 (line 449) - fishing-line-remaining meter fed by trigger-parsed 'You have (\d+) feet of line left' / cast-distance lines, not a character stat. Score/weight labels are client-side counters incremented from combat-message-style catch lines (weights parsed as pounds/ounces integers, no commas).

mechanisms.routing: variable + highlightRoom() map highlight (roomsVisited visit-count table); NOT a gauge
mechanisms.notes: Reads player's current room id from IRE-style GMCP: `local roomNum = tonumber(gmcp.Room.Info.num)` (string, tonumber'd). Used only to count/colour room revisits on the mapper, not to display any player positional gauge. This is the ONLY character-adjacent datum the package reads; no hp/mp/xp/etc. Requires IRE-style gmcp.Room.Info (config.lua explicitly says 'works with all IREs and any game which models its gmcp after the IRE ones').

mechanisms.routing: PromptBar.setHP(matches[3],matches[4]) -> setGauge("HP", current, max, "cur / max") legacy createGauge
mechanisms.notes: hp current=capture grp2 (matches[3]), max=grp3 (matches[4]); prompt line is gagged with deleteLine(). Plain integers, no commas/percents.

mechanisms.routing: PromptBar.setMP(matches[5],matches[6]) -> setGauge("MP", current, max, text) legacy gauge
mechanisms.notes: mana current/max = grps 4/5 (matches[5]/[6]) shown as N/N on prompt.

mechanisms.routing: PromptBar.setMV(matches[7],matches[8]) -> setGauge("MV", current, max, text) legacy gauge
mechanisms.notes: movement points (mv) current/max = grps 6/7 (matches[7]/[8]); MUD 'movement/moves' resource.
alignment: sign=grp8 (matches[9], the -? capture), value=grp9 (matches[10]); gauge max hardcoded to 1000.

mechanisms.routing: PromptBar.setTNL(matches[11],1333) -> setGauge("TNL", max-current, max, text); max hardcoded 1333
mechanisms.notes: TNL = experience 'to next level' (grp10 / matches[11]); max hardcoded 1333, and displayed value is inverted (current = max - tnl).
MONITOR = monitored target/enemy health cur/max in trailing <cur/max> of prompt (grps 11/12 = matches[12]/[13]); when value is '-' (no target) gauge is zeroed.

leading (.*) status/condition text (matches[2]) rendered as a length-based gauge (max hardcoded 9). Whole package assumes the user has set the Avatar MUD prompt to the exact form '<-100/120hp 50/60mp 30/40mv -50 200tnl-> <cur/max>'. Uses legacy createGauge/setGauge, NOT Geyser; passive prompt parsing, sends no command to elicit.

Materia Magica uses LOWERCASE gmcp keys: `myhp = tonumber(gmcp.char.vitals.hp)` (value is a STRING, tonumber'd). Max = mymaxhp, sourced from gmcp.char.maxstats.maxhp (see UpdateMaxStats) with an observed-max clamp `if (mymaxhp < myhp) then mymaxhp = myhp` and a hardcoded default of 4000 if never set.
sp = spell points / mana (string, tonumber'd). Gauge labelled 'Mana'. Max mymaxsp from gmcp.char.maxstats.maxsp + observed-max clamp + hardcoded default 4000.
st = stamina, gauge labelled 'Endurance' (string, tonumber'd). Max mymaxst from gmcp.char.maxstats.maxst + observed-max clamp + hardcoded default 4000.

mechanisms.routing: mymaxhp,mymaxsp,mymaxst = tonumber(...) module variables (feed the vitals gauges' max)
mechanisms.notes: This is the maxima provider for hp/sp/st. Guarded by `if (gmcp.char.maxstats)`. Values are strings, tonumber'd. On login the package SENDS `protocol gmcp sendchar` (trigger 'GMCPSendChar' firing on the 'Materia Magica is brought to you' banner, line 891) to make the server start emitting char GMCP.

tnlpct = experience 'to next level' PERCENT (already 0-100), used directly (not tonumber'd) with a hardcoded max of 100; clamped to 0 if <1 in UpdateVitals. Repurposes the 'Willpower' gauge to show XP%.

mechanisms.trigger_name: affects (child of affects.list group, gated by 'You are affected by the following:')
mechanisms.notes: Parses the `affects` command spell list into myAffects.affects table. Not routed to any gauge/label - stored in a Lua table only. affects.list parent (line 318) resets myAffects on 'You are affected by the following:' and Total-end (line 417 `^Total of (\d+) magical affects.$`) closes the multiline capture.

mechanisms.pattern: ^\* You are resistant to: (.*).$  |  ^\* You are vulnerable to: (.*).$  |  ^Racial: (.*)$
mechanisms.notes: Three sibling triggers in the same `affects`-command parse block capture resistance/vulnerability/racial lists into myAffects sub-tables (lines 325/345/365). Comma or space separated lists, stored as variables, not displayed.

mechanisms.pattern: ^The world becomes blue-tinted for a moment, then fades back to normal.$ (combat blink on); ^The hardened air around you dissipates.$ (armor off); etc.
mechanisms.trigger_name: My Affects group: combat.blink/armor/shadow armor/detect invisibility/haste/levitation/stone skin/protection from good/bless/sanctuary/pentacle/sense life/infravision
mechanisms.notes: ~13 buff/affect on-off trigger pairs (lines 36-832) each call doAffect(name, on/off) to maintain the myAffects.affects list in real time from combat/spell-fade messages. infravision.on additionally reads gmcp.char.base.name (line 813) to confirm the message refers to the player before flagging. None of these drive a gauge/label - buffs are tracked in a Lua table only.

mechanisms.pattern: ^You are in '(.*?)' in (.*?) on the continent of (.*?)\.[ ]+[(]Coordinates:[ ]+([0-9]+)x, ([0-9]+)y; Global: ([0-9]+)x, ([0-9]+)y[)]$
mechanisms.routing: raiseEvent("BatMap.event.locationUpdated", matches[4]=continent, matches[5]=x, matches[6]=y) -> moves world-map pointer/label
mechanisms.notes: Captures player world position from BatMUD `whereami` output: continent name (grp3/matches[4]) + local coords x,y (grps 4/5 = matches[5]/[6]); global x,y (grps 6/7) are captured but unused. Plain integers. The 'update' trigger (line 142) SENDS `@whereami` (or BatConfig.movementCommand) on movement/travel/portal lines to elicit this, debounced 0.3s; the echoed whereami is gagged. Not a vitals gauge - drives a map-position pointer via Geyser.Label style padding.

mechanisms.routing: variable only (Player.Pl); get_health()=floor(Pl/MaxPl*100) fed to prompt label + CK.tick event
mechanisms.notes: POWERLEVEL is this game's HP analog. MSDP delivers plain integer (no commas). Player:get_health() at line 82 computes floor(Pl/MaxPl*100), returns 100 as fallback on first login.
The max used to scale the POWERLEVEL 'health' bar.

Max for the KI/energy bar.

Max for the fatigue/stamina bar.
God-Ki secondary resource; GODKI at 2752, GODKI_MAX at 2755. Used in is_rested() check.

mechanisms.notes: Dark energy resource; DARK_ENERGY at 2800, MAX_DENERGY at 2804.
Base power level used for item-tier calc (API:item_tier).

Needs meters; HUNGER 2820, THIRST 2824.
Rage meter. Also parsed from the prompt line's [Rage: n] token (see Prompt trigger).

mechanisms.routing: variable only; echoed into prompt line
mechanisms.notes: Gravity training values; MAX_GRAVITY 2768, ROOM_GRAVITY 2771. Prompt trigger echoes '[room / maxG x G]'.

mechanisms.trigger_name: MSDP Target Health / MSDP Target Max Health
mechanisms.notes: Enemy/target health via MSDP; OPPONENT_HEALTH 2844, OPPONENT_HEALTH_MAX 2847. Note MSDP delivers current-and-max here so an enemy gauge is fully scalable.

mechanisms.trigger_name: MSDP Target Name / MSDP Target Level
mechanisms.notes: OPPONENT_NAME 2850, OPPONENT_LEVEL 2854. Combined with prompt [Target:] flag to detect combat.
Identity; CHARACTER_NAME 2707, RACE 2715.

mechanisms.routing: raised event (MSDP:report_names sent on sysConnectionEvent and on prompt-staleness)

mechanisms.notes: Parses the single-line output of the MUD2 'fes' command (full status dump). matches.sta / matches.maxSta -> M2Stats:updateFes -> updateTheStuff. maxStamina taken directly from same line (maxSta). Same 'fes' line as the stamina entry; matches.mag / matches.maxMag are the MUD2 'magic' resource (the game's mana-equivalent). maxMagic taken same-line from maxMag. magicbar hidden/blank when magic == 0.

Remaining fields from the same 'fes' line: effStr/str (effective vs max strength, shown as effStr/str), effDex/dex (effective vs max dexterity), pts (points/score, comma-stripped via :gsub(',','') then numWithCommas re-added for display), blind/deaf/crip/dumb (Y/N affliction flags -> boolean, shown as Bl/Df/Cr/Dm status text), mins (minutes to next reset), weather (single letter F/C/R/S/O/T/B mapped to a word). str/dex maxima are the raw stat on the same line; str/dex rendered as current/max labels, not gauges.

mechanisms.notes: Four alternative regexes (4 entries in regexCodeList) that catch stamina changes between full 'fes' polls, mainly in combat. 'Stamina=X/Y.' and 'X hits you (cur/max).' carry max on the same line (same-line); 'fallen from N to Y.' and 'Your stamina is X.' give only current, so updateStam keeps the previously known maxStamina and clamps via observed-max (if stamina > maxStamina then maxStamina = stamina). Hybrid maxima: same-line when present, else retained/observed.
